In the manga, Kaiju No. 10 was a very tall and muscular humanoid kaiju, with a crimson-colored carapace, dull spikes on the back, and a long spiky tail. It had an elongated cranium with a sharp horn on the front and a cross-like cavity on the face, with multiple teeth around, connected to its upper jaw. Its mouth was large with two rows of teeth, sharp on the more external row and squared in the internal row. Inside its mouth, he had one circular blue eye placed, visible from the cross-like cavity on its face.[7] In the anime, Kaiju No. 10's skin is colored red with magenta energy flowing through the openings, and had purple muscles and blood when injured.

It could also morph into a second gigantic form, with spikes on its shoulders (tipped with magenta in the anime) and with its cross-like cavity opened to show its internal eye.[8]

After being defeated by the Third Division, Kaiju No. 10 had been reduced to a head with its spine connected to its damaged core.[9] It was later weaponized into a Numbers Weapon, taking the form of a dark-grey scaly combat suit with a long mechanical tail and Izumo Tech's logo on the shoulder pads and tail.[1] The suit features No. 10's signature cross-shaped eye, now red, and long green energy lines on the arms and tail.[10]

Personality

Kaiju No. 10 is a ruthless and intimidating individual, driven to the utmost to accomplish its missions. He also seems to be quite confident, being a proud leader of a pack of kaiju and challenging the strongest member of the Defense Force he could find.[7]

It seems to like fighting strong enemies, to the point of extending fights and taunting its rivals just for the sake of it.[11] Its prideful personality brings him to never admit defeat, but rather a "draw", even when almost at death point.[12] Its fight with Soshiro Hoshina managed to exicite it so much that, even after being defeated, it still felt linked to Soshiro and wished to be turned into a weapon for him, to fight with him once more. No. 10 seems to be a rather independent individual, easily betraying its progenitor Kaiju No. 9 just to get closer to Soshiro.[5]
Plot

Raid on Tachikawa Base Arc

Kaiju No. 10 attacked the Tachikawa Base with his dozens of Preondactyl Kaiju, to collect Force members of the Defense Force.[4] It then faced Soshiro Hoshina head-on, proving to be on par, if not superior, with Kaiju No. 8's power.[7] As it kept on rushing Soshiro, No. 10 eventually destroyed Gate Number Three and got ready to finally finish off its opponent before having its arm detached by an unrestrained Soshiro.[11] With the fight going on, Kaiju No. 10 was slashed multiple times by Soshiro's blade style, until it suddenly morphed his appearance.[13] Upon growing in size, No. 10 easily resisted Soshiro's attack and, after spotting him behind himself, swatted him away with a powerful punch.[8] With Soshiro getting back up and continuing to fight, the kaiju eventually grabbed him to kill him, only to be shot in the shoulder by the Captain of the Third Division herself Mina Ashiro.[14] After this hit, the kaiju was furtherly attacked by Soshiro, Mina, and Kikoru Shinomiya, who were able to expose its core and shoot it, thus destroying it apparently.[15] After its giant body fell to the ground, a massive bomb made out of the Preondactyl Kaiju it guided appeared in the sky, with No. 10, now reduced to a decapitated talking head, taunting Soshiro by calling their fight "a draw". Moments later, much to its own disbelief, he saw Kaiju No. 8[12] jumping in the air to punch the Yoju-bomb away in the sky.[16] Kaiju No. 10's head was subsequently taken into custody by the Third Division.[9]

Power & Abilities

Overall Abilities: Kaiju No. 10 is an extremely powerful Identified kaiju, with a fortitude level of 8.3 when it first appeared,[7] and 9.0 after using it’s full power and growing larger in size.[8] The vice-captain of the Third Division of the Defense Force, Soshiro Hoshina, acknowledged that this kaiju could be on par with No. 8[7] since it was able to resist multiple attacks from Soshiro.[13] Even after being defeated, No. 10 still mantained a fortitude level of 5.7, despite being reduced only to a mere head without a body.[5]
Powers

Immense Strength: With just one of its punches, Kaiju No. 10 was able to crack concrete walls and pummel Vice-Captain Soshiro on the defensive.[7] After becoming enormous, the kaiju could destroy massive buildings with ease and send Soshiro flying away through several blocks with just one punch.[8]
Immense Speed and Reflexes: Kaiju No. 10 seems to be fast enough to elude even the eye of a combatant of Soshiro's caliber, who is able to slash kaiju with extreme rapidity. Its reflexes seem to be incredibly fast too.[7]
Immense Durability: Kaiju No. 10 has proved to endure multiple attacks from a combatant of Soshiro Hoshina's caliber without showing any sign of sufferance or fatigue.[13]
Regeneration: Kaiju No. 10 seems to be able to heal itself upon getting slashed or injured.[13]
Gigantification: By growing in size, Kaiju No. 10 gains much more power, with its Fortitude reaching its highest point. In this form, it is able to effortlessly push a high-ranking member of the Defense Force on the defensive.[8]
Shapeshifting: Kaiju No. 10 can grow appendages and even eyes everywhere on its body.[8]
Projectile Firing: Kaiju No. 10 can fire projectiles by flicking its fingers. Its shots are powerful enough to damage entire buildings.[7]
Kaiju Control: Kaiju No. 10 is able to easily control other kaiju at will, using a sonar signal to guide them.[7]

Aoi Kaguragi (神かぐ楽ら木き 葵アオイ, Kaguragi Aoi) is a young member of the Third Division of the Defense Force.[5] After the destruction of Tachikawa Base,[6] he was temporarily transferred to the Second Division [1] before coming back to the Third Division.[2]

Aoi is a tall, muscular, and tan-skinned young man with spiky short mint green hair, red eyes where he has a noticeable lack of eyebrows and he usually sports a serious look on his face.[3]

On duty, he wears the Defense Force uniform as well as its combat suit on the battlefield.[3]
Personality

Aoi has a very serious demeanor, always doing his best to be on top and better than his peers and doing what he must to grow stronger and surpassing others.[3] Despite his sometimes cold character, he hides a lot more of his emotions then he lets out.[4] As a metter of fact, due to his proud personality, he shares a rivalry with Haruichi Izumo, another very capable trainee.[7]
History

Aoi was a rising star at Japan Ground Self-Defense Force, but turned down his future in the JGSDF to apply to the Defense Force.[3]
ADVERTISEMENT

Plot

The Man Who Became a Kaiju Arc

Aoi took on the second-stage exam for the Defense Force and he arrived first in the fitness test, but he kept his eyes on Kikoru Shinomiya despite that.[3]

For the aptitude test, he managed to draw 15% from the Defense Force Suit,[8] but during the test, he was unable to keep up with Kikoru.[9] After the end of the exam and the subsequent accident, he and the other examinees were brought to safety.[10] Days later, he was officially made a member of the Defense Force.[5]

Sagamihara Neutralization Operation at Daybreak Arc

Two months after Aoi and the others had the shooting training, he told Haruichi Izumo that he caught up to his force after unlocking 25% of his suit power. That night he and the other boys were in the bathroom talking about their reasons to enter the Defense Force. When he and the others heard that Kafka Hibino had a history with Captain Mina Ashiro, they talked about it so much that they overheated and fainted. That night, a kaiju appeared and their first mission started [7] where he and Haruichi quickly demonstrated their incredible ability in the field to their platoon leader Nakanoshima.[11] Then, he and Haruichi got ready to defeat all the Yoju after the Honju's death.[12]

Days later, Aoi and his peers has a kendo traning session at Tachikawa Base, followed by journalists from Metro TV and Aoi decided to challenge Vice-Captain Soshiro Hoshina, a swords specialist. Despite being defeated, Aoi thanked Soshiro and said he'd work harder with Soshiro praising him and acknowledging his remarkable skills.[13]

Raid on Tachikawa Base Arc

During the raid, Aoi, Haruichi Izumo and Ryo Ikaruga fought the Wyvern-type kaiju under Kafka Hibino's instructions. As Aoi and Izumo were about to kill a kaiju, they were saved by Kikoru Shinomiya's surprise ax attack.[14] He later witnessed as Kafka transformed into Kaiju No. 8 to save everyone from a Yoju-bomb.[15]

Kaiju No. 8 Captured Arc

When Kafka Hibino was captured and brought away,[16] Aoi and the others were offered a place in another division since the Tachikawa Base was mostly destroyed. After Leno Ichikawa decided to accept, Aoi followed him in hoping to become stronger.[6]

At some point, Aoi and Haruichi Izumo were transferred to the Second Division.[1]

Kaiju Weapon Arc

After Director General Isao Shinomiya's death at the hands of Kaiju No. 9, Aoi and Haruichi Izumo payed homage to him with the rest of their division.[1]

The Compatible User Arc

At some point after the attack at the Tachikawa Base, Aoi texted Kafka Hibino to check on him.[17]

Months later, Aoi and Haruichi Izumo found out that Leno Ichikawa became the first compatible person in history with Kaiju No. 6's weapon.[18]

The Last Wave Arc

In the climax of the No. 9-induced cataclysms all over Japan, Aoi and Haruichi Izumo appeared in Kasumigaseki Area to fight against the Third Wave. As Haruichi was striking them down with his bow, Aoi reported their entrance as newly joined members of the Third Division.[2]

Personality

Ebina is a short-tempered [2] and loud officer, not minding showing a rude and confrontational attitude in order to speak his mind.[3] In spite of his harsh demeanor, Ebina recognizes and acknowledges people's skills and support.[1]
History

At some point in history, when Mina Ashiro offered Soshiro Hoshina to become her Vice, after the latter's visit at Tachikawa Base, Ebina stormed his captain's office to inform her that a miniature kaiju emerged in Ome City. As Soshiro proposed to aid the Third Division, Ebina quickly reprimanded him before Mina agreed to Soshiro's offer.[3] On the way to Ome City, Ebina reprimanded Soshiro for being too relaxed. He then revealed to Soshiro that he knew his family and that the instructor of the Third Division praised Soshiro's sword skills. However, he made sure to remind Soshiro that "times have changed", referring to Soshiro's unsuited skillset for modern battlefields. On the scene, Ebina informed his men that some Lizard-type Kaiju emerged, and their job was to neutralize the yoju that a previous platoon failed to kill. Subsequently, the group engaged four yoju, successfully taking down one. However, as another one escaped, Soshiro promptly decided to chase it, despite Ebina's order to wait. After Soshiro defeated it, Ebina commended the officer, but when Soshiro faced a stronger and more mature yoju, Ebina and his men had to intervene to kill it and save Soshiro. Reunited, Ebina ordered Soshiro to look for some stranded children he was informed of, despite Soshiro's wish to fight more. Ebina then told him he did a good job, but he wasn't suited to fight against those kaiju, leaving Soshiro to his new duty.[1]

During the Raid on Tachikawa Base, Ebina and his platoon arrived to aid the rest of the Third Division against the Wyvern-type kaiju.[2]

During the raid, Haruichi, Aoi Kaguragi and Ryo Ikaruga fought the Wyvern-type kaiju under Kafka Hibino's instructions. As he and Aoi were about to kill a kaiju, another one attacked Haruichi before he was saved by Kikoru Shinomiya's surprise ax attack.[16] He later witnessed as Kafka transformed into Kaiju No. 8 to save everyone from a Yoju-bomb.[17]

Kaiju No. 8 Captured Arc

After Kafka Hibino was taken into custody,[18] Haruichi and the others were asked by Captain Ashiro to transfer to another division since Tachikawa Base was mostly taken down during the attack. Watching the others accept, Haruichi followed them, hoping to surpass Kikoru Shinomiya.[6] Awating transfer, Haruichi and Aoi discussed Kafka's fate in private, with Aoi mentioning his contacts in the JGSDF potentially vouching for Kafka.[19]

At some point, Haruichi and Aoi Kaguragi were transferred to the Second Division.[1]

Kaiju Weapon Arc

After Director General Isao Shinomiya's death at the hands of Kaiju No. 9, Haruichi and Aoi Kaguragi payed homage to him with the rest of their division.[1]

The Compatible User Arc

At some point after the attack at Tachikawa Base, Haruichi texted Kafka Hibino to check on him.[20]

Months later, Haruichi and Aoi Kaguragi found out Reno Ichikawa became the first compatible person in history with Kaiju No. 6's weapon.[21]

The Last Wave Arc

In the climax of the No. 9-induced cataclysms all over Japan, Aoi Kaguragi and Haruichi appeared in Kasumigaseki Area to fight against the Third Wave. As Aoi announced their entrance as newly joined members of the Third Division, Haruichi used his bow and arrows to struck down two kaiju from the Third Wave, lamenting how their first opponent out of training was a horde of Daikaiju.[2]

Iharu Furuhashi (古ふる橋はし 伊イ春ハル, Furuhashi Iharu) is a young officer of the Third Division of the Defense Force.[3]

After the destruction of Tachikawa Base, he was transferred to the Fourth Division.[4]


Appearance

Iharu is a tall athletic-looking young man with messy pink hair shaved on the side, orange eyes and sharp teeth.[3]

In battle, Iharu wears the usual combat suit of the Defense Force,[5] as well as the usual uniform when on duty.
Gallery

Iharu's profile
Iharu's profile
Personality

Iharu is an hot-blooded and proud individual who doesn't like to be inferior to other people or losing, and constantly tries to improve more than those he deems stronger than him.[6] For this reason, he targeted Leno Ichikawa, bragging with him whenever he has the chance to do so.[6] Iharu is described as an headstrong character who brightens up every environment he's in.[1]

Despite his apparently confident attitude, Iharu hides a big inferiority complex towards his peers, mostly due to his past life of success which he now compares to his current life in the Defense Force, where most of his collegues improve faster than him.[7] As a matter of fact, when pushed into difficult and life-threatening situations, Iharu displays a more fragile and insecure side, being aware of his own weaknesses and even admiring someone stronger than him like Leno himself.[8] Deep down, he values his own team and teammates more than he would admit.[2] Nevertheless, he's shown to be determined and very stubborn, refusing to give up and facing evey wall in his path to improve himself.[2]
History

Back when Iharu was still in middle school, he was saved from a kaiju by Mina Ashiro. This event would later inspire him to become a Defense Force member.[6].

While attending Hachioji Neutralization Technical College, Iharu'd always been the top of his class, having the best score in every test, being the best at sports and mostly in everything, quickly becoming popular and admired by his classmates. This made Iharu believe he could become the best in anything he wanted developing an overinflated ego.[7] He later graduated valedictorian.[3]
Plot

The Man Who Became a Kaiju Arc

Iharu took on the second-stage exam for the Defense Force. He finished third in the fitness test, but kept his eyes on Kikoru Shinomiya, having the desire to crush her.[3]

For the aptitude test, he managed to draw 14% from the Defense Force Suit,[5] however during the test he was unable to keep up with Kikoru.[9] After the end of the exam and the subsequent accident, he and the other examinees were brought to security.[10] Days later he was officially made a member of the Defense Force.[11]

Sagamihara Neutralization Operation at Daybreak Arc

Two months after he and the others had the shooting training Iharu was able to draw 20% of his suit. He quickly went to boast about it with Leno. That night he and the other boys were in the bathroom talking about their reasons to enter the Defense Force. When he and the others heard that Kafka Hibino had a history with Captain Mina Ashiro they talked about it so much that they overheated and fainted. That night a kaiju appeared and their first mission started.[6] During the mission, dispatched in Ikaruga Platoon,[12] Iharu was left speechless by Leno's incredible fighting prowess and improvement.[13] After the Honju's death, a great number of Yoju rushed towards the Defense Force and while Iharu and Leno were facing them they encounter a strange disposal crew member.[14] As the crew member was revealed to be the kaiju who injured Kikoru, Leno and Iharu engaged in combat with him. Upon getting injured Iharu was asked by Leno to run away and call the cavalry.[15] As Iharu was running away the remorse of always being protected, from Mina Ashiro in his past and from Leno now, and not improving as Leno did get the best of him and, despite his injuries, came back to save Leno's life and aid him fighting the kaiju. As Leno was able to put the kaiju down the latter emerged from a barrage of corpses, ready to fight again.[16] Iharu was then incapacitated but tried his best to prevent the kaiju from killing Leno. As he realized that he had no chance to save him, Iharu prayed for his friend's life before Kaiju No. 8 appeared and saved Leno from the Humanoid Kaiju, who got decapitated with one fist, much to Iharu's shock.[8] He could only watch as the battle between the kaiju went on until the Defense Force arrived.[17]

After waking up in the hospital two weeks later he and Leno were discharged and celebrated along with the other Corps members their first mission. During the party, he discussed the mission with his peers. As they were all discussing the mission he watched as Soshiro announced Kafka's promotion to Corps member of the Third Division of the Defense Force.[18]

Raid on Tachikawa Base Arc

During the raid, Iharu and Leno helped the Defense Force to deal with the Wyvern-type kaiju.[19] He later witnessed as Kafka Hibino transformed into Kaiju No. 8 to save everyone from a Yoju-bomb.[20]

Kaiju No. 8 Captured Arc

After Kafka was taken into custody by the Defense Force,[21] Iharu couldn't help but feeling shocked by the news.[22] Then, he and the others were asked by Mina herself to transfer to another division, since Tachikawa Base was mostly destroyed. Despite being initially reluctant, Iharu accepted to prove Leno that he wouldn't lose to him.[22]

At some point, Iharu and Leno were transferred to the Fourth Division.[23]

Kaiju Weapon Arc

After Director General Isao Shinomiya's death at the hand of Kaiju No. 9, Iharu and Leno payed hamge to him with the rest of their division.[4]

The Compatible User Arc

When Leno was selected to become the user of Numbers Weapon 6, crafted from Kaiju No. 6's corpse, Iharu witnessed his compatibility test.[24] One month later, he aided Leno and the rest of the Fourth Division in a test to measure Leno's ability with the suit.[25] During the battle Iharu was repeatedly saved by Leno and, after lamenting his inability to improve like his peers, he witnessed as Leno started abusing his power out of control[7]. In the climax, Leno fought while injuring his own body in order to beat the Honju and froze an entire area just to avoid getting external help. As Captain Jugo Ogata was ready to step in and declare Leno's failure, Iharu rushed towards his friend begging his captain to still give him a chance. Breaking through the ice, he reaced Leno and encouraged him to go on and fight.[26] After carrying Leno on his back to safety and preparing a plan, Iharu used his spiking released force to expose the kaiju's core to give Leno the opportunity to kill it.[2] After they managed to complete the mission, Iharu and Leno celebrated and were brought to the infirmatory.[27] Sometime later Iharu rang Kafka, after the latter had refused Leno's call, and expressed how much he was afraid of Kafka's kaiju form despite still considering him a precious ally.[28]

Power & Abilities

Overall Abilities: Iharu is a strong young officer within the Defense Force, easily proving to be one of the best rookies of his year. Before joining the Defense Force, he ranked number one in his class constantly, being the strongest of his peers.[7] In battle, Iharu is skilled and determinated enough to follow the likes of Leno Ichikawa and provide him support even against major threats like Kaiju No. 9. He was even likened to a division captain of Jugo Ogata's caliber, due to his innate abilities with his suit.[27]
Powers

High Unleashed Combat Power: Iharu was initially able to release 14% of his combat suit's power and later 20% after two months.[5][6] Iharu's current stable released force is 24%, allowing him to keep up with Leno and easily break big chunks of ice.[26] However, Iharu's released suit power reaches remarkable spikes when he's engaging an enemy, going from a mere 24% to a full 42% in seconds, even unpredictably fluctuating back and forth.[27] According to Captain Ogata, who even likened Iharu to himself, Iharu's released power is on par with Ichikawa and he has potential to become a great soldier.[27] Iharu is the third recorded case of Flash Adapter, caused by a unique brain structure that doesn't allow his released force to be maintained for long. Instead he has a rapid, explosive fighting style used to overwhelm his opponent. He was taught combat methods that force him into a short trance. According the Captain Ogata if he were to master said techniques the power generated from his ability to ramp up in an instant will likely surpass Leno Ichikawa. Iharu is now able to release 88% of the suit's power.
Enhanced strength: Iharu possesses enough physical brawn to easily break through ice,[26] and carry injured teammates on his back for long distances.[2]
Enhanced speed: During one of his combat power spikes, Iharu is able to evade attacks from Honju.[2]
Battles

Iharu and Leno Ichikawa vs Kaiju No. 9 (Interrupted) - Chapter 14 until Chapter 17
Iharu and Leno Ichikawa vs Mole Type 67 Honju (Won) - Chapter 60 until Chapter 63
Equipment

Combat Suit: On the battlefield, Iharu wears a usual combat suit.[6]
Respirator Mask: Iharu wears a respirator mask in combat.[6]
Rifle: Iharu's main weapon of choice is a rifle.[6]
Shotgun: After training with the Fourth Division and Captain Jugo Ogata, Iharu earned a shotgun, marked SG-1108, with electrified shells provided by Izumo Tech.[29]

Isao Shinomiya (四しノの宮みや 功いさお, Shinomiya Isao) was the Director General of the Defense Force[5] (before being absorbed by Kaiju No. 9),[6] the late husband of Hikari Shinomiya[2] and the father of Kikoru Shinomiya.[7] He is also the former captain of the First Division.[8][9]

Isao is a very tall and muscular middle-aged man with short blond hair, a moustache and beard, big wild green (yellow in the anime) eyes and thick, messy eyebrows that usually shows a serious look on his face.[5][10]

Ten years ago, Isao had a more youthful appearance and lacked his moustache.[11]

Isao's combat suit was special compared to the standard combat suit's worn by other Defense Force members. It was designed to fit him only, so it was given a dignified jet-black look with a military atmosphere, without making the lower body too tight.[12]

Personality

Isao is a very authoritative and serious man, being also very demanding towards his subordinates and his daughter Kikoru Shinomiya.[2] As the Director General of the Defense Force who has served many years in it’s ranks, he is a far-sighted man who gave his orders firmly in sight of future threats and is also not above using living kaiju as weapons to empower the Defense Force.[13]

Isao's strong romantic relationship with his wife Hikari Shinomiya brought him to be very affected by her death and ever since then, he became cold and distant with Kikoru, demanding her to become the "perfect soldier" so that she wouldn't suffer the same fate as her mother.[2] His strictness wasn't limited to just his family alone as he acted the same way with his subordinates and his former student Gen Narumi.[8][14]

However, despite his apparent cold and serious behavior, Isao showed a more caring side when he remembered Kikoru's words about Kafka Hibino and when he personally informed the latter about his decision to keep him alive, going against his high-ranked colleagues to give Kafka a chance to prove himself to them.[13] Until the end, his only concern was the sake of the next generations, fighting for it with all of his might to ensure a safer future to those after him, to the point of being willing to sacrifice himself like his wife did.[15]
ADVERTISEMENT

Power & Abilities

Overall Abilities: Isao was the Director General of the Defense Force and had absolute authority over the entire organization. In the past, he was known as the "strongest soldier" in the entire history of the Defense Force,[16] although Isao himself admitted that he had grown weak (due to old age) and his current strength was a mere shadow of it's former glory.[15] Despite this, he was still strong enough to fight on par with a berserk Kaiju No. 8[17][18] and nearly kill Kaiju No. 9,[15] two of the strongest kaiju's in the entire series. Even Gen Narumi, the current captain of the First Division and "Japan's Strongest Anti-Kaiju Combatant", stated that he could never beat Isao.[8][14]
Powers

Shield: While wearing Numbers Weapon 2, Isao was able to produce a shield that could protect him from powerful attacks. His shield was strong enough to withstand attacks from a berserk Kaiju No. 8.[17]
Maximum Output: Isao used his shield at maximum power.[18]
Sonic Attacks: Through the usage of Numbers Weapon 2, Isao was able to use Kaiju No. 2's ability to produce sonic blasts, expanding the range of his strikes.[17]
Energy Attacks: While using Numbers Weapon 2, Isao could release highly destructive energy that is similar to electricity from his gauntlets.[18] He could also use Kaiju No. 2's Main Burst attack which almost completely destroyed Sapporo.[19]
High Unleashed Combat Power: As the former Director General of the Defense Force, Isao was capable of using a high amount of his combat suit's power. Although the exact number of his unleashed combat power remains unknown, he was able to release the full power of Kaiju No. 2.[15]
Immense Strength: Despite being passed his physical prime,[20] Isao possessed a tremendous degree of physical strength. During his battle with Kaiju No. 8, the force of their fist colliding together was strong enough to destroy multiple layers of an extra-fortified training shelter.[17] He could also match the immense strength of Kaiju No. 9.[15]
Enhanced Speed and Reflexes: Isao was incredibly fast, being able to speed blitz and attack Kafka before he realized what happened,[10][16] and was quick enough to save Akira Kurusu from Kaiju No. 9's attack.[21] His reflexes were also remarkable, as he was capable of dodging some of Kaiju No. 8's extremely fast attacks.[17]
Immense Durability: Isao was an extremely resilient man. Due to his combat suit's defenses, he was able to endure powerful attacks from Kaiju No. 8 and continued to fight.[17][18]
Immense Endurance: Isao possessed immense levels of physical endurance and stamina. Even in old age and being severely injured with a broken left arm, he was able to get back up and fight after taking a devastating punch from Kaiju No. 9.[21][15]
Abilities

Martial Arts Mastery: Isao was an extremely skilled close-quarters combatant. His mastery in martial arts allowed him to improve his own fighting style, which was passed down to other Defense Force officers.[22] He easily overwhelmed Kafka Hibino with powerful punches,[16] fought on par with Kaiju No. 8,[17] and was even capable of exchanging blows with Kaiju No. 9 with only one arm.[15] Isao had also mastered other forms of combat such as swordsmanship and sharpshooting, and even trained Gen Narumi.[8][14]
Leadership skills: As the former Director General of the Defense Force, Isao had absolute authority over the entire organization. For more than thirty years since his days as a captain, he served as the heart of Japan's neutralization efforts.[23] Although he received objections from all of his subordinates, Isao was still willing to use a living kaiju as a weapon to empower the Defense Force, showcasing a far greater sense of duty to the protection of Japan.[13]

Isao's fighting style is named Squadron Style Combat Technique (格闘術, Kakutō-jutsu).[17] It is a fighting style focused on hand-to-hand combat, perfected by Isao himself.[22] The foundation of this fighting style is derived from the lower body where the user channels the power created with the legs into their fists.[24] Isao used it in tandem with his combat suit and gauntlets, managing to fight like a daikaiju using hand-to-hand combat techniques.[17]

Number One: Barrage Blast (1式: 蓮破, Isshiki: Hasu Yabu): Isao hit his opponent with a powerful elbow strike.[15]
Number Two: Force Blast (2式: 発破, Nishiki: Happa Yabu): Much like Kaiju No. 2 would often do, Isao expanded the range of his strikes by empowering his fist with destructive sonic blasts.[17]
Number Three: Twin Blast (3式: 双破, Sanshiki: Sō Yabu): Similar to his second technique, Isao expanded the range of his strikes by empowering both of his fists with destructive sonic blast.[18]
Number Four: Rising Blast (4式: 昇破, Yonshiki: Nobori Yabu): Isao hit his opponent with a powerful uppercut.[15]
Number Five: Spiral Blast (5式):[25]
Number Six: Thunder Emperor (6式: 雷帝, Rokushiki: Raitei): Despite being used by Kaiju No. 9 instead of Isao, this technique involves using two powerful electric fists, powered by a subsequent shockwave.[26]

Personality

Jugo seems to be a rather calm and peaceful individual, wishing to get along with his fellow division captains despite their hot-blooded and belligerent behaviours. He's not above drinking alcohol or plucking his nose hair when on duty.[2][5]

Despite his laid-back behavior, Jugo knows the risks and perils of his job and tries his best to keep his subordinates safe.[5] Due to his attachment to Hikari Shinomiya and her subsequent death, Jugo always makes sure never to endanger another of his comrades if he can help it, still regretting his encouragement that brought Hikari to her demise.[4]

History

In his youth, Jugo used trained alongside Hikari Shinomiya and was quite close to her with the two sharing some kind of rivalry.[1] When she had her compatibility test with Numbers Weapon 4 Jugo himself encouraged her before later regretting this decision ever since her death.[4]

At some point, Jugo became the captain of the Fourth Division.
Plot

Kaiju No. 8 Captured Arc

After the Raid at Tachikawa Base, Jugo welcomed Reno Ichikawa and Iharu Furuhashi into his division.

The Kaiju Weapon Arc

After Isao Shinomiya's death at the hands of Kaiju No. 9, Jugo and the rest of the Fourth Division payed homage to the deceased director general during his funeral.[6]

The Compatible User Arc

During the Anti-No. 9 Eastern Divisional Conference, Jugo and the other division captains heard the information Soshiro Hoshina obtained by Kaiju No. 10.[2] Later in the conference, it was decided that Reno Ichikawa, now serving in Ogata's division, would be the new candidate for Kaiju No. 6's suit.[7]

Jugo spent some time reflecting on the idea with his subordinate Toko, before finally informing Leno of the decision taken in the conference. Despite the captain himself advicing Leno to turn the offer down, the Fourth Division still helped Leno through the process. When Leno fainted due to the power of the weapon, Jugo visited him in the infirmatory and advice him to give up again, but since Leno was still willing to try then Jugo offered him one month to become the perfect user of No. 6's weapon.[5] A month later, Jugo and the rest of the Fourth Division tested Leno's ability with Numbers Weapon 6 by having him defeat a pack of Mole Type 67 kaiju, with him managing to defeat them all.[3] However, as Leno kept drawing more power and push his body to the limit to defeat the Honju, Jugo realized the danger for Leno [8] and got ready to step in with Toko to neutralize the Honju himself, ready to declare Leno's attempt a failure. However, the two were stopped by Iharu Furuhashi's attempt to encourage Leno to keep fighting.[9] Allowing the two to keep going, Jugo witnessed as Furuhashi unleashed unstable spikes of released force, likening his ability to his own, and then watched and Iharu and Leno defeated the Honju once and for all,[10] bursting into tears while thinking about his youth and the new young prodigies he's training. Later, he phoned Third Division captain Mina Ashiro to report Iharu's and Leno's improvments, vowing to make them top-notch soldiers, following his duty as "survivor".[4]

Kaiju No. 1 (怪かい獣じゅう1号ごう, Kaijū Ichi-gō), also known as The Future Sight Kaiju (未みら来い視しの怪かい獣じゅう, Mirai-shi no Kaijū),[2] was the first Identified Kaiju to ever receive an I.D. number.[1] After its death, it was turned into Numbers Weapon 1 (識別怪獣兵器ナンバーズ1号ごう, Nanbāzu Ichi-gō), currently used by First Division Captain Gen Narumi.[1]



ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance


1/2


Kaiju No. 1 was a massive muscular daikaiju with grey skin and multiple openings on its massive body revealing numerous pink eyes with cross-shaped pupils. The kaiju's head was similar to that of Kaiju No. 10 and No. 12, flat with sharp teeth tied by skin patches, four large dark eye socket and two bull-like horns on the side of the head.[3]

As a Numbers Weapon, it takes the form of a gray armored combat suit equipped with a black jacket.[4]
History

At some point Kaiju No. 1 was faced and killed by the Defense Force, eventually turning it into the the first Numbers Weapon, currently used by First Division Captain Gen Narumi.[1]
Plot

Cataclysms Arc

During the No. 9-induced cataclysms, Gen wore Numbers Weapon 1 to save Chieko Tokuda from a kaiju[4] and slash others around.[5]

The Second Wave Arc

When Kaiju No. 11 attacked Gen, the latter had difficulty using Numbers Weapon 1's powers due to the former's hydrokinesis ability.[6] Eventually, Gen evolved the weapon's abilities, turning its eyes green.

ADVERTISEMENT

Powers & Abilities

Overall Abilities: As an Identified Kaiju and the first with a measured fortitude level of over 9.0,[7] Kaiju No. 1 was an extremely powerful kaiju. According to Director General Isao Shinomiya, Kaiju No. 1 was a fearsome kaiju whose attacks were inescapable.[2]
As a Kaiju

Pseudo-Foresight: Kaiju No. 1's retina allowed it to see through other living things and pinpoint their weak spots, as well as giving it an enhanced vision. More importantly, this perspective is key to discerning the synaptic impulses that belong to the observed part, simulating a kind of combative precognition by being able to know in advance what an opponent is about to do. This allowed Kaiju No. 1 to unleash infallible attacks.[1]
As a Numbers Weapon

Foresight: Despite Numbers Weapon 1 having the same power as the kaiju at its core, Gen Narumi developed an advanced form of foresight that Kaiju No. 1 never possessed. In addition to electrical signs, the weapon can also sense electrons moving, temperature and terrain changes.[3]
ADVERTISEMENT
Trivia

Matsumoto stated that Numbers Weapon 1 was designed to look different from previous suits and have a Narumi-like loose feeling. Also, both this and Numbers Weapon 10 were designed the be at odds with each other, just like their users Gen Narumi and Soshiro Hoshina: therefore while Numbers Weapon 1 has more volume on the upper body, Numbers Weapon 10 has volume on the lower body.[8]

Kaiju No. 11 had the shape of a stocky and muscular humanoid grey creature, with a large whale-like head and a big shark-like fin on top. It also lacked visible eyes and had spiky plates on its back, two smaller fins of its shoulders and elbows and a pointy long tail. Befitting its fish physiology, this kaiju had gills on his torso.[2] Like No. 9 previously, No. 11 occasionally showed small circular black eyes.[3]
Personality

Kaiju No. 11 appeared to be a very intuitive creature, being also quite confident on its abilities when in a favorable situation.[4]

Due to possessing Isao Shinomiya's memories, when facing his former pupil Gen Narumi, No. 11 treated him with the same superiority of his former master. The kaiju constantly lectured and taunted Gen during their fight.[3]
Plot

The Compatible User Arc

At some point, this kaiju was created by Kaiju No. 9,[2] being given Isao Shinomiya's memories.[3]

Kaiju No. 11 then appeared on a beach in Chigasaki, Kanagawa Prefecture, where it sucked up and ate fish from the sea before leaving underwater without ever coming ashore.[2]

The Second Wave Arc

During the No. 9 induced cataclysms attacks, Kaiju No. 11 appeared in Sumida Ward to face off against First Division Captain Gen Narumi.[1] During their fight, No. 11 was pummeled by Narumi before using a water strike to land a clear punch on the Defense Force Captain, sending him flying. No. 11 then stated that while Gen could see his movements through the usage of Numbers Weapon 1, he could not read the water's movement, which No. 11 could control.[4] No. 11 later sensed the appearance of Kaiju No. 8, much to its surprise.[5] As its onslaught on Gen Narumi continued,[6] No. 11 managed to tank and counter all of the captain's attack. It then revealed that he knew about Kaiju No. 1's powers and Gen's fighting style because No. 11 possessed Isao Shinomiya's memories. After lecturing him, the kaiju then cornered Gen and taunted him for being a disappointed, before being distracted by Gen's faint and being slashed by him.[3] As Gen awakened his evolved powers from his Numbers Weapon, No. 11 was confused as no such instance was present in Isao's memories. Eventually, the kaiju was overwhelmed by Gen's newfound foresight and struck by his final attack.[7]

ADVERTISEMENT

Power & Abilities

As one of the Identified Kaiju by Kaiju No. 9, Kaiju No. 11 is an extremely powerful Daikaiju, with a Fortitude level of 9.0.[1] Its hydrokinesis-based powers make it a formidable foe for someone like Defense Force First Division Captain Gen Narumi, who uses the electrical imputs from his opponent's brain to read and anticipate their movements.[4]
Powers

Immense Strength: Kaiju No. 11 possessed immense physical strength, allowing it to easily send a fighter of Gen Narumi's caliber flying with one clear punch.[4]
Immense Resistance: Kaiju No. 11 was resistant enough to endure multiple attacks before countering on its own.[4]
Shapeshifting: Like its siblings and parents, Kaiju No. 11 could morph its appearance to an extent.
Muscle Enlargement: Kaiju No. 11 could increase the size of its arms to land more powerful strikes.[4]
Hydrokinesis: Kaiju No. 11 could use hydrokinesis, allowing it to easily control large bodies of water and use them for offensive purposes.[2] Kaiju No. 11 demonstrated controlling water from the ocean to make it rain fish, controlling the water from the sewage system in his fight with Gen Narumi, summoning waves and streams of water to sweep opponents off their feet and shaping them into dense water spheres to fire them as projectiles.

Kaiju No. 12 looked almost identical to its prototype Kaiju No. 10. It was a large light-grey humanoid kaiju with a dark-scaled muscular body and a long tail. It had a squared head very similar to No. 10's, the main differences being two horns on the sides of the head, its red eye having two vertical openings and its mouth only sporting sharp teeth.[1]
Personality

Kaiju No. 12 was an apathetic and silent creature, creating a stark contrast with its loud and battle-hungry prototype/sibling, Kaiju No. 10. No. 12 was also very good at adapting mid-fight and coming up with countermeasures against its enemies. It is subtly depicted to enjoy battling with worthy adversaries and is also gracious in defeat as it is seen smiling at Soshiro after besting it in battle before dying.
History

At some point this kaiju was created by Kaiju No. 9, as the finished product of Kaiju No. 10.[2]
Plot

The Second Wave Arc

During the No. 9 induced cataclysms attacks, Kaiju No. 12 appeared in the Chofu Airport area to face off against Third Division Vice-Captain Soshiro Hoshina.[1] During the battle, No. 12 was able to fight on equal grounds and eventually overpower Soshiro by turning its arms into blades.[3] No. 12 later sensed the appearance of Kaiju No. 8, much to its surprise.[4] As its battle with Soshiro continued, No. 12 managed to corner the vice-captain and break his swords.[2] As No. 12 continued, Soshiro grabbed a backup katana and switched to a different sword style, allowing him to chop off one of its hands.[5] Pummeled by Soshiro's new style, No. 12 still managed to endure all of the Vice-Captain attacks until it was able to adapt, spawning a blade of its own and copying Soshiro's single-blade style[6]. Using the new style, it was able to turn the tables again, cutting off the No. 10 suit's tail in a single slash.[7] After continuing its onslaught, No. 12 found itself facing a three-sword wielding Soshiro, who invented a new technique on the spot and manage to stab No. 12's core, with the help of No. 10's tail.[8] Even after its core was pierced, it regrew an arm and attempted to keep fighting, surprising an exhausted Hoshina. Its core breaks down before it can move further, though, and the Vice-Captain offers the kaiju his praise as it collapses and dies.[9]

ADVERTISEMENT

Power & Abilities

As one of the Identified Kaiju created by Kaiju No. 9, Kaiju No. 12 was an extremely powerful Daikaiju, with a Fortitude level of 9.0.[1] Kaiju No. 12 was created as the improved version of Kaiju No. 10,[5] who already was a powerful daikaiju on its own right, and according to Keiji Itami and Konomi Okonogi, it was highly possible that No. 12 was created specifically to combat and exterminate Third Division Vice-Captain Soshiro Hoshina.[3]
Powers

Immense Strength: Kaiju No. 12 possessed immense levels of superhuman physical strength, far superior to that of Kaiju No. 10,[2] able to send a grown man flying and devastate a large area with a single slash attack.[3]
Immense Speed: Kaiju No. 12 was able to move at immense speeds, far faster than its prototype, Kaiju No. 10.[2]
Shapeshifting: Kaiju No. 12, like its siblings and parent, could partially morph its appearance and body.
Blade creation: Kaiju No. 12 could turn its forearms and hands into extremely sharp and durable blades.[3] It could also detach the blades in order to create its own sword.[7]
Abilities

Master Swordsman: Kaiju No. 12 had displayed a high-level of skill in fighting with swords, making extreme close-quarters combat its specialty. No. 12's proficiency with blades was on par or greater than Soshiro Hoshina, the Defense Force's strongest close-quarters combatant.[6] Despite being at a disadvantage after Soshiro switched to a Single-Blade Form, No. 12 soon began adapting to his fighting style, replicating the same technique, taking full advantage of its regenerating arm, while shifting it into a sword.
Adaptability: No. 12 had shown the ability to evolve and adapt mid-fight to better respond to its enemy's fighting style. Even when an enemy of Soshiro's caliber switched fighting technique, No. 12 quickly adapted and countered with a newly adapted move.[6]
ADVERTISEMENT

Equipment

Flesh Sword: No. 12 created a long sword-like blade made out of its own body. The sword is strong and resistant enough to break through Defense Force equipment[6] and damage a Numbers Weapon.[7]

Kaiju No. 13 then appeared on the Tohoku expressway, Tochigi Prefecture, near the Kamikawachi service area, competing with cars by running at high-speeds for 12 kilometers before disappearing.[2]

The Second Wave Arc

During the No. 9 induced cataclysms attacks, Kaiju No. 13 appeared in Oizumi.[1] It was later targeted by the First Division platoon leaders.[6] During the fight, it managed to gain the upper hand on the First Division with no injuries, even almost killing Platoon Leader Tachibana.[3] When Platoon Leader Rin Shinonome fired at him with her machine gun, No. 13 tanked the bullets and punched her strong enough to destroy her weapon. Then, No. 13 was attacked by Rin with a freezing grenade and a rifle, only to quickly move next to her and punch her to the ground. As the kaiju was about to kill her, Rin was suddenly saved by Kafka Hibino, much to No. 13's surprise.[4] However, as Kafka transformed into Kaiju No. 8, No. 13 became very enthusiastic and eager to fight him, promptly enhancing his muscles by running on the spot. It then rushed towards Kafka at high speeds to deliver a powerful punch, only for No. 8 to block it and punch No. 13 into a wall instantly, effectively killing it.[5]

ADVERTISEMENT

Power & Abilities

As one of the Identified Kaiju created by Kaiju No. 9, Kaiju No. 13 was an extremely powerful Daikaiju, with an initial Fortitude level of 9.0[1] and a subsequent level of 9.2 when powering up its body.[5] It was powerful enough to easily face the First Division of the Defense Force without getting injured.[3] However, Kaiju No. 13 was not powerful enough to be a match to significantly stronger kaiju like Kaiju No. 8.[5]
Powers

Shapeshifting: Like its parents and siblings, Kaiju No. 13 possessed some degrees of shapeshifting.
Muscle Enlargment: By running on the spot very quickly, Kaiju No. 13 could stimulate its muscles to the point of drastically enlarging them.[5]
Immense Speed: Kaiju No. 13 could easily run at high-speeds, competing with cars on an expressway[2] and effortlessly blitzing its enemies.[4][5]
Immense Strength: No. 13 possessed remarkable degrees of physical strength, with its blows easily sending a high-ranking Defense Force officer flying or cracking the ground.[4]
Immense Stamina: No. 13 could easily tank machine gun shots and shrug them off with no injuries.[4]

No. 14 took the appearance of a jet-black floating parallelepipedon with four pink human-like faces on its angles, the faces sporting a eerie smile.[2]
Personality

Nothing was known about No. 14's personality, except that it was a silent yet destructive kaiju.
Plot

The Compatible User Arc

At some point, this kaiju was created by Kaiju No. 9.[2]

No. 14 then appeared in Ageo City, Saitama Prefecture, at 3:20 on the Shonan-Shinjuku line, smiling eerily at a train full of passengers before flying away.[2]

The Second Wave Arc

During the No. 9 induced cataclysms attacks, Kaiju No. 14 appeared in Tachikawa.[1] It was later targeted by Third Division Captain Mina Ashiro.[3] Using its teleportation ability, No. 14 was able to avoid being targeted by Ashiro while blasting the city apart with energy beams and blocking barrages from lower-ranked soldiers using its force-field.[4] As Mina Ashiro took action in Tachikawa, No. 14 promptly attacked her. However, she managed to dodge and shoot back at the kaiju, much to its shock, eventually hitting No. 14.[5]

The Last Wave Arc

As Kaiju No. 14 was declared dead, its parent Kaiju No. 9 used a white version of No. 14 to forcefully open a portal through its corpse. Walking through No. 14's corpse, No. 9 manifested itself through a portal in front of Mina, ready to retrieve her incredible power for itself.[6]

ADVERTISEMENT

As one of the Identified Kaiju created by Kaiju No. 9, Kaiju No. 14 was an extremely powerful Daikaiju, with a Fortitude level of 9.0.[1] No. 14's energy beams and force fields were able to damage and shrug off Defense Force equipment with no effort whatsoever.[4]

Levitation: Much like its sibling, this kaiju could freely move mid-air.
Teleportation: Likely developed as a counter to Mina Ashiro's sniping skills, No. 14 could quickly teleport between close locations.[4]

Energy Attacks: This kaiju could project destructive beams of energy from each mouth on its head.[4]
Force-Field Generation: It was able to surround itself with a force-field durable enough to withstand fire from missiles and standard Defense Force rifles.[4]
Trivia

Kaiju No. 14 was given a monolithic appearance to give off a feeling of apocalypse and fear. Naoya Matsumoto also stated that the scene where No. 14 appears on the railway is based on the author's experience of watching the front view on the train as a child.[7]

No. 15 presented a skinny and female-looking humanoid body, with its most notable features being large brains attached to it: three on its head and several around its waist. It also possessed long fingers, a lack of feet and a feature-less face with a large cavity in the middle.[2]

In its human disguise, the kaiju looked extremely similar to Kikoru Shinomiya, with the only substantial difference between the two being black hair instead of Kikoru's blond and occasionally red eyes with black sclera. Also, in this form the kaiju wore a black school uniform for girls with a red tie.[3] Upon being created, No. 15 appeared identical to Kikoru in her childhood, with the same differences between the two persisiting. At the time, the Kaiju mostly wore a long black dress.[4]

Personality

No. 15 firstly appeared as an innocuous kaiju, calmly scouting its surrounding without attacking or even engaging humans.[2] However, when attacking, the kaiju reveals its true nature as a cruel and cunning creature, not above taunting its victims.[3]

The kaiju was very interested in Kikoru Shinomiya.[1] Even while facing her, No. 15 stayed in its Kikoru-like form and taunted her during the entire fight, calling her "Little Kikoru." Through its powers, No. 15 gave a demonstration of its sadistic nature by digging into Kikoru's subconscious and forcing her to relive her childhood trauma.[5]

Kaiju No. 15 also resembled Kikoru in personality, being quite eccentric and arrogant. Possibly inheriting Kikoru's trauma, No. 15 had a desperate need to gain the approval of its father-figure Kaiju No. 9, in the same way Kikoru strove for her father's praise. No. 9's cold and distant personality, however, motivated Kaiju No. 15 to become more powerful through training, only enough to gain its affection, with killing Kikoru proving to be the ultimate challenge to achieve that. Kaiju No. 15's despair upon realizing it was just No. 9's pawn and that its love will never be reciprocated, caused a deep pain in its heart, desperately begging for its progenitor's affection even as it died.[4]
ADVERTISEMENT

Plot

The Compatible User Arc

At some point, this kaiju was created by Kaiju No. 9, after the latter had killed Isao Shinomiya.[4] Ever since being created, No. 15 seeked No. 9's love and affection like a human daughter would from her father. However, its emotions were used by No. 9 to manipulate No. 15 into getting stronger for the former's goal, being oblivious to affection and seeing its spawn as nothing but a pawn.[4]

Kaiju No. 15 then appeared in Shibuya Ward, Tokyo, at the scramble intersection of the Hachiko exit gate. There, it proceeded to observe its surroundings for three minutes and then leave.[2]

Cataclysms Arc

Three month later, the kaiju disguised itself as a human before attacking some bystanders in Kabukicho, Shinjuku.[3]

The Second Wave Arc

During the No. 9 induced cataclysms attacks, Kaiju No. 15 appeared in the National Diet area to face off against First Division Officer Kikoru Shinomiya.[1] Right after being recognized as a Numbered Kaiju and being given its Kaiju No. 15 codename, the latter quickly unleashed an attacks that eliminated the officers who were aiding Kikoru, much to her shock. As it morphed back to its human form, No. 15 mocked Kikoru, who then got ready to neutralize it.[6] Mocking Kikoru who announced No. 15's neutralization, the kaiju quickly attack her with multiple powerful blows, overwhelming her in strength and speed, eventually breaching through her Numbers Weapon's shield. Stating that Kikoru's axe isn't enough to kill it, Kaiju No. 15 then morphed its left arm into a giant axe to eliminate Kikoru.[7] However, Kikoru evaded the attack at the last and, while following her mother's ghost through the suit, she eventually managed to hit No. 15 once in the face, although slightly.[8] Eventually, Kikoru managed to reach her maximum Combat Power and expose No. 15's core, only for the kaiju to release a psychogenic attack on her opponent. Inside Kikoru's subconscious, Kaiju No. 15 questioned her on her reason to become stronger, only to make her reveal that all she ever wanted was her parents' praise. Upon this revelation, No. 15 taunted her saying that her parents were dead and she couldn't be praised by them ever again, with Kikoru falling in despair.[5] No. 15 later sensed the appearance of Kaiju No. 8, much to its surprise. Sensing its immense power after he defeated Kaiju No. 13, No. 15 acknowledged No. 8's superior power and proposed reuniting with its fellow kaiju to take him down, before noting Kikoru getting back up[9] As Kikoru found her resolve in proving to be a worthy Defense Force officer, No. 15 found itself pummeled by the young soldier, who eventually delivered a fatal blow.[10] In its last moments of life, No. 15 showed her psyche and memories to Kikoru, revealing how much it wanted to gain Kaiju No. 9's approval only for the latter to see it as a simple pawn. Despairing, Kaiju No. 15 was then killed by Kikoru.[4]

ADVERTISEMENT

Power & Abilities

As one of the Identified Kaiju created by Kaiju No. 9, Kaiju No. 15 is an extremely powerful Daikaiju, with a Fortitude level of 9.0.[1] While also being very destructive in its attacks, this kaiju is powerful enough to easily kill multiple Defense Force officers without effort and take on a skilled Numbers Weapon user.[6][7]

No. 15 seems to the worst opponent for someone like Kikoru Shinomiya, using its mental powers to work around Kikoru's unparalleled strength and using her insecurities against her, as also noted by Defense Force Director General Keiji Itami.[11]

Flight: Kaiju No. 15 has shown the ability to move itself freely in the air.[2]
Immense Strength: No. 15 possesses superhuman amounts of physical strength, allowing it to fight on par with a officer of Kikoru Shinomiya's caliber, even while wearing a Numbers Weapon. Its blows can easily crack buildings and solid concrete with little to no effort.[7]
Immense Speed: No. 15 showcased remarkable levels of speed even for a Daikaiju, quickly evading and catching up to Numbers Weapon 4, the fastest one in the Defense Force arsenal.[7]
Shapeshifting: Like its parent, Kaiju No. 15 has showcased shapeshifting ablities. It can morphs parts of their body in order to turn them in weapons, assimilating nearby objects to transform its arm in a giant axe for example.[8]
Regeneration: No. 15 displayed high levels of regenerations, being able to instantly heal its detached arm.[5]
Metamorphosis: Kaiju No. 15 can morph into a human form and blend in with other humans.[3] Differently from No. 9, No. 15 doesn't have to consume a human in order to take their appearance, and it can only take the form of Kikoru Shinomiya, since the kaiju was modelled off her.
Energy Beams: No. 15 attacks by releasing an extremely powerful and violent beam of energy from its mouth. Its attacks can scatter in different directions to take out various targets,[3] or release a singular beam powerful enough to instantly wipe out an entire Defense Force platoon and destroy a building in just one blow.[6]
Psychological Manipulation: No. 15's most unique ability its affecting the psyche of its victims. By touching a target with a beam of energy, the kaiju can connect to the victim's brain and thus manipulate it in different ways. During its psychogenic attacks, the victim stops moving and in enthralled by the kaiju's powers.
Telepathy: No. 15 can read the mind of its targets and pinpoint specific events or emotions, even digging into their subconscious.[5]
Memory Induction: After reading the mind of its victims, No. 15 can force them to recollect memories and traumas from their life.[5]
Mental Control: No. 15's mind control enables the kaiju to conjure a black white space where the victims can take any form the kaiju wants and even see illusions created by No. 15 through the target's memory.[5]

Kaiju No. 2 (怪かい獣じゅう2号ごう, Kaijū Ni-gō), also known as The Daikaiju of Destruction (破壊の大怪獣, Hakai no Daikaijū),[3] is an Identified Kaiju and the second kaiju to ever receive an I.D. number.[1] After being killed by the Defense Force, it was converted into Isao Shinomiya's Numbers Weapon 2 (識別怪獣兵器ナンバーズ2号ごう, Nanbāzu Ni-gō), before being eventually absorbed by Kaiju No. 9.[2]

Kaiju No. 2 is an olive-green kaiju with a round stocky body covered in rocky plates, a long rocky tail and short thick arms with three fingers each. It has a white reptilian-like head with fourteen shining yellow eyes and a large mouth full of sharp teeth.[1]

Its former appearance as a Numbers Weapon was that of a scaly black armor and two silver-colored metal gauntlets, reaching the wearer's biceps and sporting two large black pipes on each forearm.[1]

Since being absorbed by Kaiju No. 9, No. 2 has now regained his original form, although fused with No. 9's improved form and drastically shorter than before.[3]

According to Keiji Itami, Kaiju No. 2 had an immense sense of pride, holding on to it until its very death.[1]
ADVERTISEMENT

History

In 1972, Kaiju No. 2 attacked and nearly destroyed Sapporo, until it was defeated and killed by the Defense Force. Its corpse was then repurposed as the base for Isao Shinomiya's combat suit and gauntlets.[1]
Plot

Kaiju No. 8 Captured Arc

When Kafka Hibino was transferred to the Ariake Maritime Base, Isao Shinomiya used Kaiju No. 2's power to face an uncontrollable Kaiju No. 8.[1]

Kaiju Weapon Arc

After Isao's fight against Kaiju No. 9, No. 9 managed to absorb Kaiju No. 2's power, offering it to "return to the kaiju side".[2]

Powers & Abilities

Overall Abilities: As an Identified Kaiju, Kaiju No. 2 was a tremendously powerful and destructive monster, able to pose a threat to a whole city. Its power made its weaponized corpse is so strong that only a man of Isao Shinomiya's caliber could handle its might. As matter of fact, Isao, while using No. 2's power, was able to easily and heavily injure Kafka Hibino in his kaiju form, gaining himself a power on par with that of a Daikaiju,[1] despite being well passed his prime. however, it cannot withstand Kaiju No. 8's power when the Mysterious Larva took over and managed to defeat it.
As a Kaiju

Immense Strength: As a giant-class Identified Kaiju, No. 2 had enough power to almost completely destroy a city.[1]
Immense Durability: No. 2 boasted remarkable resistance among its fellow Daikaiju, as its neutralization was very long.[1]
Sonic Attacks: Kaiju No. 2 used to expand the range of its attacks with powerful sonic blast.[4]
Energy Attacks: Kaiju No. 2 has shown the ability to release highly destructive energy, similar to electricity, from its mouth.[5] The suit that was forged from its corpse is also able to release super high levels of electromagnetic energy. This power, along with the rest of No. 2's weaponized body was absorbed by Kaiju No. 9.[6]
As a Numbers Weapon

Shield: While wearing Numbers Weapon 2, the user is able to produce a shield that can protect them from powerful attacks.[4]
Sonic Attacks: Through Numbers Weapon 2, the user can access No. 2's sonic powers. The result are extremely powerful blows with a much larger range of action.[4]
Energy Attacks: Numbers Weapon 2 allows the user to release massive amounts of energy to attack the enemy from afar.[5]

Kaiju No. 6 (怪かい獣じゅう6号ごう, Kaijū Roku-gō),[3] also known as The King of Kaiju (怪かい獣じゅうの王おう, Kaijū no Ō),[2] was an Identified Kaiju that was neutralized by the Defense Force ten years ago.[3]

After its death, it was converted into Numbers Weapon 6 (識別怪獣兵器ナンバーズ6号ごう, Nanbāzu Roku-gō) [2] and it is currently used by Fourth Division officer Reno Ichikawa.[1]



ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance


1/2


Kaiju No. 6 was a massive dark-scaled kaiju shaped much like a theropod dinosaur, possessing short arms and large legs. Its head was elongated and equipped with a long maw with sharp teeth, while the top of its cranium had two long pointy horns on the sides. Kaiju No. 6 also possessed dorsal plates and four incredibly long tails, with their size dwarfing even its main body.[1]

Its current appearance as a Numbers weapon is a dark blue combat suit with a beetle-like texture. The suit possesses various pipes and cables from which cold energy flows.[1]
History

Ten years ago, Kaiju No. 6 was at the center of various cataclysms which brought the death of 200 Defense Force officers and 3 captains, with Second Division Captain Hikari Shinomiya being the most notable victim.[3]

After its death, its corpse was converted into weaponry by the Defense Force. However, since there wasn't anybody compatible with the weapon, it was abandoned in cold storage.[3]
ADVERTISEMENT

Plot

Kaiju No. 8 Captured Arc

After his attempt to execute Kaiju No. 8, and his subsequent brutal fight with him, Isao Shinomiya would use Kaiju No. 6 as a topic to the argument of whether or not Kaiju No. 8 should be weaponized, since there is no guarantee that any Defense Force member would be compatible with the manufactured weapon and so it was probably in the Force's best interest that they keep Kafka alive for the time being.[3]

The Compatible User Arc

During the Anti-No. 9 Eastern Divisional Conference, the four divisions of the Defense Force discussed their plan to kill Kaiju No. 9 and, while talking about training the new recruits, the topic of Kaiju No. 6's weapon was brought up. Discussing a possible compatible user for it, Third Division Vice-Captain Soshiro Hoshina proposed young talent Reno Ichikawa as a potential candidate.[2] After this decision, Reno tested the Numbers weapon aided by the Fourth Division, and he successfully used it in battle against a Mole Type 67 kaiju one month later, officially becoming the weapon's wielder in the Force.[4]

ADVERTISEMENT

Powers & Abilities

Overall Abilities: Kaiju No. 6 was described as an extremely powerful and dangerous Identified Kaiju, even earning the title The King of Kaiju.[2] It had a fortitude level of 9.6 when it was alive and managed to guide an unparalleled cataclysm alongside multiple Honju-level kaiju.[1] Such cataclysm is still recognized as one of the most catastrophic ever, which even brought about the death of Hikari Shinomiya, the then-Second Division Captain. With its attack unleashing a snowstorm in Odawara, its name is still recognized as a "Symbol of Despair" to people. After being converted into a weapon, the Defense Force couldn't find anyone to match its power and it was always seen as the most powerful and dangerous weapon in the Defense Forces arsenal. Even as a Numbers weapon, its power is still strong enough to knock down a talented young officer like Reno Ichikawa.[3][1]

Cryokinesis: Kaiju No. 6 seems to have had ice-related powers. Its mere presence on the battlefield caused a giant snowstorm and the suit that was forged from its corpse is able to emit cold energy.[5]

Personality

Keiji seems to be a serious and rational man who is well-informed about kaiju and the history of the Defense Force and he seems to highly respect Isao Shinomiya, both for his position and his power.[3]

Keiji was very loyal and close to his superior Isao, being a dependable Deputy Director and calmly filling in what Isao lacked.[1] He trusted Isao to the point of letting him fight Kaiju No. 9 alone, firmly believing in his superior.[5]
History

Despite his initial dislike of being in a position above others, Keiji was strongly requested by Isao Shinomiya himself to become the Deputy Director of the Defense Force.[1]

In the past, Keiji discussed with Isao about a young Gen Narumi with Keiji theorizing that Gen could surpass Isao despite the former's discorderly conduct.[6]
ADVERTISEMENT

Plot

Kaiju No. 8 Captured Arc

When Kafka Hibino of the Third Division was revealed to be Kaiju No. 8, Keiji suggested disposing of him and convert him into weaponry, before Director General Isao Shinomiya himself ordered to have Kafka secured at the Ariake Maritime Base.[7] Then, when Kafka arrived, Keiji watched with Kikoru Shinomiya as Isao attacked Kafka, confused at the fact that Isao didn't kill Kafka immediately.[8]

Kaiju Weapon Arc

Keiji, Isao Shinomiya and Juzo Nogizaka watched the First Division's fight against Kaiju No. 9 and the Ant-type Kaiju from the temporary base.[9] When Kaiju No. 9's true body appeared there too to collect Kaiju No. 2's power from Isao, Keiji stopped Juzo from joining Isao in fighting the kaiju, following the Director General's orders and evacuating the place.[5]

After their fight and Isao's death, Keiji and Juzo attended Isao's funeral with the rest of the First Division at Ariake Maritime Base.[10]

The Compatible User Arc

During the Anti-No. 9 Eastern Divisional Conference, Keiji took part as the newly appointed Director General of the Defense Force, giving the word to Third Division Vice-Captain Soshiro Hoshina to reveal the insight he was given from Kaiju No. 10 on No. 9 and his plans.[4]

Some time later, Keiji and other Defense Force high-ranking members discussed the unsolved kaiju cases than unfolded in the last month, preparing a plan to face the new No. 9-induced cataclysm.[11]

Cataclysms Arc

During the Cataclysms, Keiji watched from afar as the Defense Force faced the multiple kaiju which appeared in Japan. From the Ariake Maritime Base, Keiji then watched as Kikoru Shinomiya was dispatched with her new weapon Numbers Weapon 4.[12]

Upon watching her fighting the kaiju at the National Diet Building, Keiji realized how Kikoru was just like both of her parents, not just her mother Hikari Shinomiya.[13]

The Second Wave Arc

As the new quintet of Identified Kaiju appeared, Keiji realized there were no reinforcements to send on the battlefield, even though fighting kaiju that powerful was a job suitable for a platoon of captain-level officers and not a first-year rookie like Kikoru.[14] While following Kikoru Shinomiya's fight with Kaiju No. 15, Keiji was concerned before seeing Kikoru improving mid-fight and theorizing she was seeing her mother Hikari Shinomiya's Ghost through the memories of Numbers Weapon 4.[15] Later, as No. 15 unleashed its mental powers to incapacitate Kikoru,[16] Keiji started to wonder why these new Identified Kaiju were so accurate in their attacks, ultimately stating that they were created with the purpose of targeting specific members of the Defense Force and eliminate them.[17]

The Last Wave Arc

After Mina Ashiro managed to eliminate Kaiju No. 14, thus ending the Second Wave, Keiji listened in shock as Kaiju No. 9 made a speech through Defense Force comms, stating the war was its win.[18] Then, Keiji's reacted in shock as Akira Kurusu announced that No. 9 appeared in Tachikawa Base.[19]

ADVERTISEMENT

Powers & Abilities

Overall Abilities: Keiji is the newly appointed Director General of the Defense Force[4] and it can be assumed that he is a powerful combatant.
Abilities

Leadership Skills: Due to both his current and past high-ranking roles in the Defense Force, Keiji possesses remarkable leadership skills, able to easily calm down a situation between hot-blooded division captains.[4]
Keen Intelligence: While observing most of the fights around him, Keiji showcased remarkable levels of intelligence and intuition, rarely breaking from his collected persona and always gaining a quick understanding of the situation at hand.

Konomi is a petite young woman with black hair styled into a ponytail and big dark eyes covered by large round glasses.[2]

She wears the usual Defense Force uniform, a couple of sizes larger than her.[2][1]
Personality

Konomi is a determined and professional person. She doesn't seem to approve of Soshiro's unprofessional remarks and blurts of laughter, caring deeply for him and for everyone else when they are in danger.[2] In return, she's held in high regard by Soshiro.[1]

While working, Konomi displays a professional and serious behavior, quickly getting a grasp of the current situation to offer support to her comrades. She also displayed remarkable levels of intuition and analytical skills.
Plot

The Man Who Became a Kaiju Arc

During the aptitude test of the examination, she checked the vitals of the examinees as they were fighting, along with Soshiro Hoshina.[2] Later, an unknown humanoid kaiju resurrected one of the test Kaiju and elevated its strength, injuring Kikoru in the process as she attempted to hold the line and allow the other examinees to escape with their lives. Through the sensors, Konomi determined that the revived Honju has a fortitude of 6.4 which was something that it never was from prior to being captured by the Defense Force. She was then left at the surveillance feeds by Ashiro and Hoshina, who made their way to the training grounds with armed gear.[3]

Soon, Konomi detected an energy surge somewhere near the 6.4 Honju; separate from thereof and evidently exceeding so. Suspecting that this is coming from a newer and even stronger organism, she reports her findings to the Third Division's Captain and Vice-Captain, who were still on their way to the battlefield. Hoshina implores her for details. However, visual confirmation was rendered impossible due to the dust cloud and debris clouding that area. Sensors, on the other hand, reveal that this new source has a fortitude of over 9.8.[4]

Sagamihara Neutralization Operation at Daybreak Arc

Months later she helped the Defense Force fight off a Fungal-type kaiju by informing everyone of Kafka Hibino's discovery on the Yoju's core location.[5] Later she accompanied Vice-Captain Hoshina to ask people working at Professional Kaiju Cleaning Company Monster Sweeper Inc. about their new worker Takamichi Hotaka.[6]

Raid on Tachikawa Base Arc

At the beginning of the raid, Konomi intercepted the multiple kaiju who arrived on the scene and dispatched Soshiro's orders to the rest of the Defense Force.[7] She then helped Soshiro in his fight against a new humanoid kaiju,[8] and later assisted both him, Captain Mina Ashiro and Kikoru Shinomiya finishing off the kaiju.[9] After the kaiju was seemingly defeated, a massive yoju-bomb fell from the sky before Okonogi could sense the presence of a kaiju whose fortitude number was 9.8. Having already seen those stats, she informed everyone that Kaiju No. 8 appeared on the scene.[10]

Cataclysms Arc

When the Third Division took action during the cataclysms, Konomi monitored and followed Vice-Captain Soshiro when he fought wearing Numbers Weapon 10, containing the conscience of Kaiju No. 10, much to Konomi's concern.[11]

The Second Wave Arc

After Soshiro's mission in Chofu Airport, Konomi monitored him during his fight with Kaiju No. 12, being utterly shocked at the fact that the kaiju was putting Soshiro on the defensive. She then theorized that the kaiju was created exactly to defeat Soshiro, with Keiji confirming her thoughts.[12] As she kept following Soshiro's fight with No. 12, Konomi then witnessed as her Vice-Captain unleashed 100% of Numbers Weapon 10's combat power.[13]

ADVERTISEMENT
Powers & Abilities

Despite not being active on the battlefield on her own, Konomi is a skilled analyst and operations leader for the Third Division. Her ability to quickly understand the situation and support the officers in battle has proven indicative for victory more than once.
Abilities

Keen Intelligence: Konomi's intuitive and analytical side make her a very valuable asset for her division.

Personality

Masahide is a loud and gentle man with, apparently, no problem in telling the truth even if it means to hurt someone.[1] He seems to get easily-irritated when his comrades start to lose confidence in difficult situations, holding great trust towards the Defense Force.[3]

Masahide also hides a deeply selfless side, quickly helping other bystanders during a kaiju attack and willing to sacrifice his life to save that of his daughter Chieko Tokuda.[4]

According to his subordinates, he can be pretty cool sometimes despite being a heavy drinker and a gambler, who doesn't go above borrowing a sum of money as big as 50'000 yen from his colleague Ichitaka Mitsuike.[3]
ADVERTISEMENT

History

Ever since his daughter Chieko Tokuda was born, Masahide raised her with his kaiju-disposal business money.[4]
Plot

The Man Who Became a Kaiju Arc

Masahide and the rest of the guys at Monster Sweeper Inc. witnessed the Third Division's neutralization of a massive kaiju in Yokohama. Then, he and the rest of his squad proceeded with the disposal of the kaiju's corpse, with his squad teaming up with Iida Cleaners to strip the kaiju's arms.[1] Later after that, Leno Ichikawa joined Monster Sweeper Inc. as a part-timer with Masahide introducingd him to Kafka Hibino. He and his team then disposed of a kaiju with Leno and Kafka before they two were attacked by another kaiju after work.[1]

At some point, a strange guy joined Monster Sweeper Inc. with nobody knowing he was secretly a shape-shifting kaiju.[5]

Sagamihara Neutralization Operation at Daybreak Arc

Months later, after Kafka Hibino and Leno Ichikawa became members of the Defense Force, Masahide and his colleagues followed up the battle against an enormous Fungal-type kaiju and the Third Division. Then, upon watching the situation from a distance, they wondered where the newbie went.[6]

Later that day, they were visited by Third Division Vice-Captain Soshiro Hoshina and Konomi Okonogi to discuss their newbie Takamichi Hotaka and his strange behavior.[7]

Kaiju Weapon Arc

In the aftermath of the fight between the First Division and the Ant-type kaiju guided by Kaiju No. 9 in Shinagawa, Masahide and the rest of the guys at Monster Sweeper Inc. were sent to dispose of the dead Ant kaiju. As they were cutting the corpses, Masahide reprimanded his comrades for losing confidence after Defense Force Director General Isao Shinomiya's death and the evacuation outside the country due to Kaiju No. 9, believing that the Defense Force and Kafka would defeat No. 9 so Monster Sweeper Inc. could dispose of its body.[3]

Cataclysms Arc

Masahide was attending his daughter Chieko Tokuda's wedding when a kaiju attacked the venue. As the kaiju was about to devour Chieko, Masahide did his best to distrct the kaiju. Failing to do so, he witnessed as Captain Gen Narumi quickly took action to save Chieko and slay the kaiju.[4]
